body: His teams are +2 in his 2026-27 games, which takes his career total to +342: #29 all time counting this season, up from #30 at the end of 2025-26.
He has passed 2 players this season; the most decorated of them is Michael Jordan (+340).
stories.headline: Kawhi Leonard moves past Michael Jordan on the career wins-minus-losses list
